summary: These DOM event changes improve text editing and input behavior, especially for native IME composition, selection events, and notifying editors when composed content is removed. They add reliable support for Accel+Shift+V plain-text paste in inputs and textareas, normalize clipboard DataTransfer formats, and correct character-position queries and SVG text handling. Pointer-lock movement, status-bar updates, and SpeechRecognition error naming are also made more consistent with platform and web expectations.
